The toxic combination of unfair elections and crude majoritarianism is spreading from modern authoritarian regimes to illiberal leaders in what are still partly democratic countries. Increasing-ly, populist politiclans—once in office—claim the right to suppress the media, civil society, and other democratic institutions by citing
support from a majority of voters. The resulting changes make it more difficult for the opposi-tion to compete in future elections and can pave the way for a new authoritarian regime.
